versions.changelog:
- 移除了 OKX 相关标签，更新对 OKX 依赖的表述
- 文档文字优化，部分字段描述更准确
- skill 适用/不适用场景说明更新
- 其他小幅文档调整和表述优化

Initial public release – EVM multi-chain transfer with local signing and OKX broadcast.

- Supports native token (e.g. BNB) and ERC20 transfers on BSC (chain_index "56")
- Automatically handles nonce, gas estimation (fixed for native, estimated ×1.2 for ERC20), and local signing
- Private key stays local; sends signed transaction via OKX Web3 API
- Returns tx_hash, explorer URL, and OKX order ID on success
- Supports optional MEV protection for eligible chains (currently BSC)
- Requires configuration of wallet and OKX Web3 API credentials via environment variables
- Provides both Python and CLI usage examples
